Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent to burn or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk), and inadvertently forgetting the stove is only negligence.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not binding formal sources; they are material sources that may enunciate or evidence customary law depending on content, voting, and state practice.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” gives the grantor a right of entry that must be exercised, so the state holds a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent.
